subject: Re: Redwood demo recap & VPC/dedicated follow-up
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@fintrust.com>
Cc: Lukas Meyer <lukas.meyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 10 Sep 2026 15:20:00 -0700
Subject: Redwood demo recap & VPC/dedicated follow-up

Hi Priya —

Thanks again for taking time today — appreciate you walking through FinTrust's inference needs. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can keep momentum: 

Key notes from call:
- Primary use case: real-time fraud scoring for payments; peak ~200 rps, typical ~60 rps.
- Latency target: P95 < 200ms for scoring path.
- Data sensitivity: PCI-adjacent; preference for customer-managed networking / VPC or on-prem for production data.
- Compliance: SOC 2 in scope; you'll need audit logs + KMS integration.
- Timeline: Q4 evaluation, procurement & security review in parallel.

Recommendation:
Given the data sensitivity and procurement ask, our Dedicated / Private options (VPC peering or on-prem package) are the cleanest fit — they give you isolated capacity, KMS integrations, and a private control plane. I’ve attached a short VPC checklist that outlines networking & IAM items your infra/procurement teams typically ask for. Also attaching a high-level Dedicated pricing worksheet so you have rough numbers for budgeting.

Proposed next steps:
1) I can join a short call with your infra/procurement to walk the checklist and answer any implementation questions — 30 mins.
2) If procurement prefers, we can convert the pricing sheet to a formal SOW and start an internal procurement review.
3) I’ll follow up next week if I don’t hear back to check timing/prioritization.

Attachments: redwood-vpc-checklist.pdf, redwood-dedicated-pricing.xlsx

Would Thu or Fri next week (15/16 Sep) work for a 30-min call with your infra lead?

Best,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0198

Marissa — we’re aiming to start procurement/security reviews this month. I’ll propose some times for a quick call once Rahul confirms availability.

Priya —

Just circling back on the checklist/pricing I sent last week — wanted to check whether procurement/infra had a chance to review and whether this is still on track for Q4. If priorities shifted, totally understand — can you share an updated timing window?

If it helps, we can do a targeted 20-minute call with Rahul to walk the network items and typical firewall routes (I’ll bring Lukas, our solutions engineer). We can also provide a short stub SOW to speed procurement.

Two options for next steps: 
- Quick infra sync (20–30m) — I can do Wed/Thu mornings in your timezone next week.
- Pause and re-evaluate timing — if Q4 is no longer likely, let me know new target and I’ll update our plan.

Attached again: redwood-vpc-checklist.pdf (2nd copy)

Thanks —
Marissa

Marissa —

Apologies for the radio silence — procurement had a higher-priority onboarding this month and Rahul was pulled onto an outage. We are still interested in Redwood and the Dedicated/VPC approach, but procurement is asking for two items before we can proceed: 
1) A brief one-page security summary that calls out SOC 2, KMS support, and audit log retention.
2) An estimate for monthly committed capacity vs pay-as-you-go for 200 rps baseline so they can compare TCO.

Can you send those two items? If you can, I’ll get procurement back in and we can schedule the infra sync for week of Oct 12.

Thanks —
Priya
